seo_title: LGBTIQA+ Social Network & Gay Dating App
seo_description: Your colors. Your people. Discover the LGBTIQA+ community on CoolVibes, make friends, explore gay dating, and build meaningful connections.

hero_description_2: Say hello to a world that loves you for you.
hero_note: Be yourself. Connect. Color your world.
scroll: Let’s get to know each other

discover_desc_2: all the colors of connection live here.
community_body: Share your story and follow people who inspire you. Find each other in a song, an idea, a shared excitement.
dating_body: Gay dating and queer connections at your pace. Find a shared spark, make the first move, and discover the rest together.
nearby_body: Discover people and queer-friendly places around you. Turn an on-screen hello into a real-life memory.
messages_body: Talk, laugh, get to know each other. Sometimes the best way to share yourself and discover someone is simply “hello”.
safety_tag: You matter. Your privacy does, too.
safety_body: Stay in control as you express yourself. You decide what to share, who to talk to, and when to take the next step.
faq_1_a: CoolVibes is a social network and gay dating app for the LGBTIQA+ community. Discover posts, meet people nearby, match, and chat. Friendship, dating, or a sense of belonging: the kind of connection you want is up to you.
faq_2_a: CoolVibes is for LGBTIQA+ adults aged 18 and over and everyone who respects the community. Lesbian, gay, bi, trans, intersex, queer, ace, or still exploring: you don’t need to fit into a box here.
faq_3_a: No. You might be looking for a friend, people with shared interests, a new conversation, or romance. CoolVibes brings social sharing and dating together in one place.
faq_4_q: How can I manage my privacy?
faq_4_a: Review your account’s privacy settings, manage photo visibility, and block unwanted contacts. You decide when and with whom to share personal information. Read our privacy policy for details.
faq_5_q: Do I need to download an app?
faq_5_a: You can use CoolVibes right in your browser. Create an account and join the community from your computer or phone.
final_tag: Somewhere, someone feels just like you.
final_body: Shall we start with a hello?
